### Issue
Deprecate make_random_password().
Description
	 
		(last modified by Carlton Gibson)
	 
It's unused since fcd837cd0f9b2c706bc49af509628778d442bb3f, see also Carlton's comment.

### Candidate patch
```diff
diff --git a/django/contrib/auth/base_user.py b/django/contrib/auth/base_user.py
index f6de3b9317..cee9eb90ca 100644
--- a/django/contrib/auth/base_user.py
+++ b/django/contrib/auth/base_user.py
@@ -40,6 +40,11 @@ class BaseUserManager(models.Manager):
         allowed_chars. The default value of allowed_chars does not have "I" or
         "O" or letters and digits that look similar -- just to avoid confusion.
         """
+        import warnings
+        warnings.warn(
+            "make_random_password() is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.",
+            DeprecationWarning,
+        )
         return get_random_string(length, allowed_chars)
 
     def get_by_natural_key(self, username):
```
